generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table, never NULL; finalize (shift above compact max) before any child FK is sampled.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Sampled from the parent table's FINAL generated primary-key values (after any PK shift); nullable FKs get NULL in ~10% of rows; non-nullable FKs never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_short: Random short alphanumeric strings of length 5-20; near-duplicates allowed.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_address: Random street number + street name + city + state + zip, length 20-80.
generic_sampling_rules.char_code: Random uppercase token of length 3-15 drawn from a small pool of 2-6 distinct values per column.
generic_sampling_rules.decimal_price: Uniform in [0.01, 5000.00] rounded to 4 decimals; ~10% NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.near_variant: For equality/LIKE literals, generate values differing by one character or one numeric step.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary: For each numeric literal L with step s, include L-s, L, L+s; for dates include L-1d, L, L+1d.
generic_sampling_rules.tie: For ORDER/LIMIT columns, ensure at least two non-NULL rows share the global max value.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: Every nullable non-PK column: ~10% NULL, at least one NULL row per column per instance; planted NULLs are never overwritten to satisfy a rule.
generic_sampling_rules.composite_pk: For multi-column primary keys (Parties_in_Events, Assets_in_Events), deduplicate the tuple so no row is skipped; sample fresh tuples until unique.
